lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The anterior flank displays a high-density cluster of small, irregular high-luminance blobs, which transition into 4-5 organized horizontal rows of larger, circular spots in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a grid-like lattice pattern most visible in the posterior-mid section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally across the mid-flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the upper edge and shadow-induced low-intensity below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single remora (Echeneidae) is attached to the mid-flank, oriented horizontally posterior to the pectoral fin and ventral to the primary longitudinal ridge.
